messages:
tom: Heads-up: noticed a handful of revoke/billing events attributed to the org owner during the routing-policy canary. Not consistent but enough to spike alerts.

leah: I saw that too. Pattern looks like short-lived delegated tokens used by the Console's revoke path lose the project claim when a proxy rewrite happens.

pranav: This is different from the earlier rolebind thread 1 - here it's the delegated-token exchange that sometimes issues a parent token with only org scope.

tom: Right. Canary amplified it because the new router sends some calls via the internal auth-proxy for cold-paths. Proxy strips X-Project when it normalizes headers.

leah: Quick options: (A) make proxy preserve signed project header (add header passthrough and signature verification), (B) change token exchange to embed project in a token-bound claim, or (C) add a routing-level attribution lookup that consults a short-lived token map.

pranav: I prefer B + a fallback C. If the project is cryptographically bound to the token we avoid header rewrite fragility. Canary B later; do C quickly to protect billing.

ui: UX note: can we add a transient banner in Console billing view for customers: "Were rolling a routing update; you may see temporary attribution differences. Contact support if incorrect charges appear." Keeps support calls down.

infra-bot: action queued: create ticket ROUTE-ATTR-1780; add playbook and rollback steps.

leah: Implementation plan: 1) immediate: add auth_attrib_lookup in api-gateway that checks authn-cache for last effective project for token id (canary). 2) medium: token claim binding (JWT sub-claim "pjt") change in token-exchange service (needs migration). 3) UI: banner + revoke confirm tooltip showing billing identity. 4) backfill: small reclassification job for last 24h telemetry.

pranav: For (2) we'll need token-versioning so older tokens still validate. Add token_v=2 and verify both claims during transition.

tom: I'll add the canary to the rollout doc and set an alert on auth_attrib_lookup_rate. Threshold: >0.2% of revoke traffic -> page.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: api-gateway patch (canary) -> expected 10m.

leah: I'll open a small PR to console to attach X-Origin-Project on revoke calls and a Tooltip draft.

pranav: Good. After canary stabilizes we'll plan the token claim change with a migration window and notify partners.

tom: Thanks team. Filing incident INC-1780 and linking this thread. Monitoring now. :thumbsup:
